```{r}

library(ggplot2)
```
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(aqp)

fp_data <- read.csv("../data/Perry_FP_data_cleaned_updated_series_02_12_2026(FP_dataset).csv",
                    stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

fp_hz <- fp_data %>%
  mutate(
    Point = as.character(Point),

    top_cm_parsed = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(str_extract(To.Depth..cm., "^\\d+"))),
    bottom_cm_parsed = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(str_extract(To.Depth..cm., "(?<=-)\\d+"))),

    bottom_cm_parsed = ifelse(
      is.na(bottom_cm_parsed) & !is.na(top_cm_parsed) & !is.na(H.Depth.cm.),
      top_cm_parsed + as.numeric(H.Depth.cm.),
      bottom_cm_parsed
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(Point) %>%
  arrange(
    ifelse(is.na(top_cm_parsed), 1e9, top_cm_parsed),
    Sample.ID.Lab
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    thickness_cm = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(H.Depth.cm.)),
    thickness_cm = ifelse(is.na(thickness_cm) | thickness_cm <= 0, NA_real_, thickness_cm),

    top_cm_cum = c(0, head(cumsum(replace_na(thickness_cm, 0)), -1)),
    bottom_cm_cum = cumsum(replace_na(thickness_cm, 0)),

    top = ifelse(!is.na(top_cm_parsed), top_cm_parsed, top_cm_cum),
    bottom = ifelse(!is.na(bottom_cm_parsed), bottom_cm_parsed, bottom_cm_cum)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(is.finite(top), is.finite(bottom), bottom > top) %>%
  mutate(
    hzname = ifelse(is.na(Horizon) | trimws(Horizon) == "",
                    paste0("hz", ave(Point, Point, FUN = seq_along)),
                    Horizon)
  ) %>%
  as.data.frame()

# ---- Build SPC using the assignment form ----
spc <- fp_hz
aqp::depths(spc) <- Point ~ top + bottom
aqp::hzdesgnname(spc) <- "hzname"


```

```{r}
# horizon table
hz <- horizons(spc)

# hex colors from Munsell
hz$Matrix_hex <- aqp::parseMunsell(hz$Matrix.Color)

# write back into the SPC
horizons(spc)$Matrix_hex <- hz$Matrix_hex

# plot: hex colors + horizon labels


plotSPC(
  spc,
  color = "Matrix_hex",
  name.style ="center-center",
  hz.depths = FALSE,
  width = 0.3,      # ← smaller = more space between pedons
  cex.names = 0.6
)

```
```{r}
out_dir <- "../outputs/pedon_plots"
dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)

ids <- profile_id(spc)

for (id in ids) {

  spc_i <- spc[profile_id(spc) == id, ]

  file_name <- file.path(out_dir, paste0(id, ".jpg"))

  jpeg(filename = file_name, width = 500, height = 1200, quality = 100)

  plotSPC(
    spc_i,
    color = "Matrix_hex",
    name.style = "center-center",
    cex.names = 3,          # large font
    hz.depths = TRUE,
    depth.axis = FALSE,
    width = 0.2,
    print.id = FALSE
  )

  dev.off()
}
```
